programme.title: Suns And Lovers
programme.desc: Moya docks at a commerce station. Disaster strikes when the station is hit by a storm.

programme.title: Self Inflicted Wounds, Part 1: Could'a, Would'a, Should'a

programme.title: Self Inflicted Wounds, Part 2: Wait For The Wheel
programme.desc: The crew escapes the other ship and wormhole. Things are complicated when their new 'friends' sabotage Moya.

programme.title: Green Eyed Monster
programme.desc: Talyn is swallowed by a boodong, leaving Stark and Rygel stranded in a transport pod.

programme.title: Losing Time
programme.desc: Moya's crew starts blacking out and missing portions of time. Pilot becomes inhabited by another entity.

programme.title: Relativity
programme.desc: Talyn lands on a planet covered with healing plants. Crichton, Aeryn and Crais leave the ship to find Xhalax.

programme.title: Incubator
programme.desc: Scorpius puts the neural chip into his own brain in an attempt to retrieve vital wormhole equations from Crichton.

programme.title: Meltdown
programme.desc: Talyn wants to fly into a sun. While near it Stark is contacted by an alien woman being held against her will.

programme.title: Scratch N Sniff
programme.desc: Pilot forces Crichton, D'Argo, Jool and Chiana to take a holiday as he is fed up with their bickering.

programme.title: Infinite Possibilities, Part 1: Daedalus Demands
programme.desc: Crichton must seek out an old friend who has gained too much knowledge about wormholes.

programme.title: Infinite Possibilities, Part 2: Icarus Abides
programme.desc: Jack unlocks Crichton's wormhole knowledge so they can build a device to destroy the Scarran dreadnought.

programme.title: Revenging Angel
programme.desc: D'Argo injures Crichton, as Crichton lies in a coma/near death, he escapes into a highly animated world.

programme.title: The Choice
programme.desc: Aeryn leaves to grieve on a planet. She spots someone who might be her father but not all reunions are happy.

programme.title: Fractures
programme.desc: Escaped prisoners come aboard Moya followed shortly by Aeryn, Crais and Rygel who have returned from Talyn.

programme.title: I - Yensch, You - Yensch
programme.desc: D'Argo and Rygel meet Braca and Scorpius in a cafe to conduct negotiations when it is unexpectedly attacked.

programme.title: Into The Lion's Den, Part 1: Lambs To The Slaughter
programme.desc: The crew must stop Scorpius's research. They must board the command carrier and destroy it from within.

programme.title: Into The Lion's Den, Part 2: Wolf In Sheep's Clothing
programme.desc: Crais gets Talyn to starburst inside the command carrier, causing it to collapse in on itself.

programme.title: Dog With Two Bones
programme.desc: Moya takes Talyn's remains to the sacred burial ground. D'Argo destroys a Leviathan that attacks other ships.

programme.title: Crichton Kicks
programme.desc: Crichton, now aboard a dying leviathan, encounters an alien named Sikozu who aids him in stopping the Grudeks.

programme.title: What Was Lost, Part 1: Sacrifice
programme.desc: Everyone but Aeryn meets on Arnesk, where Jool has discovered the remains of an ancient civilization.

programme.title: What Was Lost, Part 2: Resurrection
programme.desc: The crew discovers Scorpius has fallen in the Peacekeeper ranks. They must stop the magnetic storm on Arnesk.

programme.desc: When Chris Ochoa confessed to the 1988 rape and murder of Nancy DePriest, the case was closed. 8 years later, Achim Marino confessed to the same crime. Can DNA evidence identify the real perpetrator?

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: When two boys are brutally attacked, investigators rely on evidence fished out of a nearby pond. It became the first case where diatom analysis was used to place a suspect at the scene of the crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: In 1988, the body of a young woman was discovered in an Ohio river. Most of the evidence had been washed away, but the victim's 6-year-old son unwittingly told investigators all they needed to know - without saying a word. The clue was in his genes.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: In 1991, a high school girl vanished after attending a party. The prime suspect had two alibi witnesses for the night she disappeared. A solid alibi can often overcome circumstantial evidence, but forensic evidence is another matter.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: When police discovered the body of Douglas Beamish's estranged wife, authorities linked 20 cat hairs found on her jacket to a cat owned by Beamish's parents. It was the first time animal DNA was used to solve a criminal case.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: When more than 700 Oregonians contracted food poisoning from a unique strain of salmonella in 1984, investigators uncovered a secret plot to influence local elections.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A woman is found dead from a gunshot wound and police suspect her husband, however, forensic teams prove what really happened, and the truth is stranger than fiction.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: In 1995, the founder of American Atheists disappeared with one of her sons, her granddaughter and $500,000 in gold coins. The police investigated several suspects, including David R. Waters, who worked for American Atheists.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Two people witness a truck driving over an unconscious man and flee into a nearby bar, but when the police turn up, the truck, the man and the witnesses are gone.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: In 1984, a passerby finds the torso of a woman in a cardboard box. A forensic entomologist analyzes nearby insect activity to determine when the victim was killed.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: The investigation into the kidnapping and rape of an 18-year-old Ohio woman is aided when the victim returns hours after the incident occurred. With her help, the police are able to track the assailant to his front door.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: The police investigate when a severed leg is discovered among garbage. Conventional means of identifying the victim are impossible, leading investigators to rely on DNA, forensic anthropology and toxicology.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A coroner finds telltale clues on the badly burned body of a murder victim, sending police in pursuit of a couple of killers.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: In 1996, Indiana police identified Richard Alexander as the River Park Rapist who assaulted four women that year. Later, DNA analysis casts doubt on his conviction.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: After the murder of Seattle residents, evidence from the couple's dog eventually ties a murderer to the scene.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Soon after becoming pregnant by Dr. Maynard Muntzing, firefighter Michelle Baker's health quickly deteriorates. Eventually, she raises suspicions that Muntzing is doing her harm.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: In the 1980s, a trio of unsolved murders occurred in Wichita Falls, Texas. Later, a fourth murder from the same time period provided the police with far more than they realized.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: The disappearance of Philadelphia college athlete Aimee Willard is investigated after her car is found on the roadside. When her body is found, the police find unusual marks and DNA evidence that eventually lead to her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: While investigating an apparent overdose suicide, detectives recover incriminating files from a computer.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A woman disappeared along a California highway in 1991. Three years later, the case was solved when a man's refrigerated truck was looked upon with suspicion.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: The 1987 disappearance of Houston resident Tracy Jo Shine is recalled. The investigation went cold until 2000 when a cold case squad learned that the woman's ex-boyfriend Michael Neal had bragged about killing her.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: When a 62-year-old man opens a car restoration business and becomes seriously ill, his doctors cannot find the cause, but forensics can; identification of a highly toxic metal in the victim's blood leads to his poisoner.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: After 6-year-old Michelle Lee Dorr went missing, her father confessed to murdering her. But investigators soon poked holes in his story, leaving the case unsolved for 14 years.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: The 1996 investigation into 48-year-old Martha Hansen's murder is helped by a legal requirement that bars have video cameras installed on the premises.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: When the mail-order bride of a former army sergeant goes missing, investigators look into the deaths of the man's previous two wives.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: The murders of an elderly couple leave police stumped until, two years later, they receive a major break.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: While investigating the murder of 9-year-old Jessica Knott, police use a garbage bag to connect a suspect.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: An investigation into the murder of Katie Poirier is stymied by the lack of a body. Finally, investigators use a single tooth found among some charred remains to identify her.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Janet Overton died suspiciously in 1988, and the investigation hit a dead end when the autopsy indicated no foul play was involved. A telephone tip and the sensitive nose of a forensic examiner indicated otherwise.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Discovering that an assault suspect is left-handed is crucial to a police investigation dating back 16 years.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: The only clue recovered from a shooting is a twelve-guage shotgun. Scientists use unique methods to lift the serial number from the weapon to trace it to its owner

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A serial arsonist starts several fires that cause millions of dollars worth of damage and the deaths of three people. He is discovered, partly through the use of forensic hypnosis.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: When a serial killer was terrorizing the city of St. Louis, the FBI didn't need lab tests, fingerprints or any of the usual methods. All they needed was a computer.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: In the case of the Center City Rapist and the murder of Shannon Schieber, Philadelphia authorities use an anonymous letter and geographic profiling to hone in on a suspect.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A three-year-old develops a respiratory condition. His father has Alzheimers. An investigator reveals that their ill health is due to mold in their modern home.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A murder investigation in Florida crosses jurisdictions from New York and Jamaica. The police rely on cell phone mapping, wiretapping and a host of forensic evidence to link a suspect to a murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: In 2002, the eyes of the world were on Virginia and Maryland. A serial sniper was on the loose, killing innocent, unsuspecting citizens. Just how was he caught?

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A woman convicted of killing her mother in a car fire is granted a new trial. An expert witness has a different opinion as to how the fire started and, if proven, would clear the woman of any culpability.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Authorities track a kidnapper who let his victim write a last will and informed the family of her murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A man died in his home after a history of heart disease. Rumors surfaced that the death was no accident.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: In 1999, a 12-year-old was found murdered in her home in Minnesota. Despite a meticulous search of the home and an exhaustive investigation, police had no suspects.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: In 1962, the people of the small town of Hanford, California lost their sense of peace when one of their own, 15-year-old Marlene Miller, was murdered.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A mother of two vanishes after a shopping trip. Her body is discovered a month later. Witnesses say they saw the victim being forced into a car by an unknown person.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A woman is shot to death in her store just one day before she is to testify against the man accused of robbing her. The robber becomes the prime suspect, but he has a solid alibi.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: In 1993, the state of Florida was known for more than just Disney World. Worldwide attention focused on a rash of robberies which targeted tourists.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: At a murder scene, investigators find a shoe-print, several foreign hairs, and unknown fingerprints. But they believe the most telling piece of evidence is the bite mark on the victim.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A woman's death in Pennsylvania triggers a homicide investigation into another woman's death in North Carolina.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A nurse experiences a variety of flu-like symptoms. None of her doctors are able to discover the cause, until she visits the gynecologist for a routine check-up.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Time of death becomes pivotal after a pregnant woman is found murdered in her air-conditioned bedroom.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Police were puzzled by an obscure print found at a crime scene where one man had been killed and two teenage girls were seriously injured.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A man is found dead in his home, and his ex-wife has a perfect alibi. To determine time of death, investigators need to know when the victim ate his last meal.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A union official is executed in his home not long after a strike by the union membership. Neither his wife nor anyone in the neighborhood heard any gunshots.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A man tells police he shot an intruder who killed his wife. Forensic evidence disproves that story later on.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A police officer accused of killing his estranged wife insists she committed suicide. Investigators say it was murder - that it was physically impossible for the woman to have shot herself.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: GLORY 103: Last Heavyweight Standing main event features Levi Rigters (19-3, 9 KO) colliding with Jamal Ben Saddik (38-10, 29 KO) to see who moves on in the tournament. Among the other names taking part in Phase Two are Nabil Khachab (29-6-1, 4 KO), Iancu Ionut (31-11, 13 KO), Rade Opacic (21-7, 16 KO), Milos Cvjeticanin (13-4, 9 KO), Sofian Laidouni (39-5-1, 20 KO), and many more. In addition, Chico Kwasi (44-5-2, 23 KO) will defend his GLORY welterweight world title against Mehdi Ait El Hadj (35-4-2, 8 KO), Mory Kromah (34-3-1, 20 KO) returns and takes on Cristian Ristea (44-26, 13 KO) in a heavyweight match-up outside the tournament, and Tayfun Ozcan (88-11-3, 28 KO) clashes with rival Don Sno (6-2, 3 KO).

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: Former Light Heavyweight Champion Tarik Khbabez (52-12-1, 22 KO) and Bahram Rajabzabeh (72-5, 63 KO) collide in a huge showdown for the vacant Light Heavyweight title. The penultimate round of the Last Heavyweight Standing tournament resumes with eight heavyweights competing in two separate four-man one-night tournaments. Notable participants include Levi Rigters (20-3, 10 KO), Nabil Khachab (30-6-1, 4 KO), Rade Opacic (22-7, 17 KO) and Milos Cvjeticanin (14-4, 9 KO).

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: Headlined by a high-stakes trilogy clash between Antonio Plazibat and longtime rival Nordine Mahieddine. Knockout artist Errol Zimmerman takes on former Australian strongman Alex Simon. Also, two explosive four-man, one-night tournaments in the welterweight and light heavyweight divisions—guaranteeing nonstop drama, finishes, and rising contenders.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: In the quarter finals, Belgian Moroccan Anis Bouzid (48-4, 37 KO) takes on kickboxing legend Errol Zimmerman (112-20-1, 45 KO), Serbian sensation Milos Cvjeticanin (17-5, 10 KO) meets number one French heavyweight Sofian Laidouni (42-5-1, 20 KO), monstrous Tariq ‘Cookie’ Osaro (29-4-1, 16 KO) clashes with ‘The Soldier’ Nidal Bchiri (20-5-1, 5 KO), and ‘The Black Ghost’ Mory Kromah (35-3-1, 21 KO) collides with outspoken rival Michael ‘Timebomb’ Boapeah (23-5-1, 29 KO). Only one fighter can come out on top and walk away as the new ‘King of Kickboxing’. Elsewhere, the always exciting Bahram Rajabzadeh (72-6, 64 KO) goes up against ‘The Gladiator’ Cristian Ristea (44-27, 13 KO), Hamicha (42-2, 31 KO) puts his undefeated GLORY record on the line against late replacement Brice Kombou (20-6, 5 KO), and featherweights Andre Santos (23-2, 10 KO) and Deniz Demirkapu (15-5, 10 KO) will kick-off the main card.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: GLORY featherweight world champion Petch (175-40-3, 27 KO) will rematch KO artist Abraham Vidales (18-4, 14 KO) and Portuguese sensation Miguel Trindade (64-8, 26 KO) will look to avenge his 2023 loss to the always entertaining Berjan Peposhi (32-6, 16 KO). Former GLORY title contender And leading Japanese fighter Kento Haraguchi (28-6-1, 18 KO) will go up against talented newcomer Hiroki Kasahara (39-8, 17 KO) while popular South Korean veteran Sung-hyun Lee (71-13-2, 17 KO) takes on top young prospect Yura Kono (17-1, 9 KO). In addition, the seven-fight card will be headlined by Shiro Matsumoto (55-17-4, 19 KO) defending his RISE bantamweight title against Koki Osaki (38-6-1, 21 KO). In the co-main event, budding superstar Ryujin Nasukawa (17-2, 8 KO) and heavy-hitter Kaito Hasegawa (17-2, 13 KO) battle for the vacant RISE super flyweight championship.

programme.title: Long Days of Hate
programme.desc: A bounty, Benson is hunting down a vicious outlaw gang, who killed his parents, brother and sisters, except for one sister, Susy, who he wants for himself!

programme.title: The Girl from San Lorenzo
programme.desc: Two outlaws posing as Cisco and Pancho are wreaking havoc. When the real Cisco and Pancho are captured, the criminals plan a final heist, using the duo as alibis. After breaking them out of jail, the real heroes have a chance to escape and clear their names by capturing the imposters. Will they succeed or be caught again?

programme.title: Ride in the Whirlwind
programme.desc: Three cowboys, mistaken for members of an outlaw gang, are relentlessly pursued by a posse.

programme.title: Tulsa
programme.desc: In Tulsa, after a rancher dies during a feud with a major oil company, his daughter, driven by revenge, starts digging for oil herself.

programme.title: Ben and Charlie
programme.desc: Two likable bandits try to make a living in the Old West.

programme.title: Dig Your Grave Friend... Sabata's Coming
programme.desc: Steve McGowan returns from the Civil War to find his father murdered by the ruthless landowner Miller. Seeking revenge, Steve joins forces with the bandit Pompero. Things take a turn when they capture Helen, Miller's fiancée. With the deadly gunslinger Sabata now hunting them, alliances are tested, and the fight for justice intensifies.

programme.title: The Return of Jack Slade
programme.desc: Jack Slade, son of a legendary lawman, infiltrates a ruthless gang of outlaws to bring them down from within. After his friend is killed, Slade sets a deadly trap with the help of a Pinkerton agent. Deception, betrayal, and revenge ride hard in this classic Western showdown.

programme.title: The Capture
programme.desc: A badly injured fugitive explains to a priest how he came to be in his present predicament.

programme.title: Three Bullets ... For a Long Gun
programme.desc: Nobody knows his true name, but everybody knows he is the Major, and that when he wants something, he gets it.

programme.title: The Last Traitor
programme.desc: Ned Carter is waiting with a bunch of guests for his bride. When they notice there are exactly 13 people at the table, an unlucky number, some think it's an evil omen.

programme.title: Wanted
programme.desc: A local sheriff is unjustly accused of murder in a small town and forced to flee.

programme.title: Clint the Stranger
programme.desc: Gunslinger Clint Harrison returns home seeking redemption, only to find his family gone because of his dark past. Tracking them down, he’s drawn into a violent land war between struggling farmers and a ruthless rancher willing to kill for control.

programme.title: Bury Them Deep
programme.desc: An army payroll is robbed by Billy Gun. The Army hires Clive Norton to recover the money. To help him, Norton rescues from the gallows a man who especially despises Gun.

programme.title: Comanche
programme.desc: Common efforts of the U.S. government and the Comanche nation to negotiate a peace treaty are sabotaged by renegade Indians and by the short-sighted Indian Commissioner.

programme.title: The Over the Hill Gang
programme.desc: A retired Texas Ranger and his three aging pals are hired to clean up a lawless town.

programme.title: You're Jinxed, Friend You've Met Sacramento
programme.desc: This fast-moving tale revolves around the kidnaping of a boxer's daughter. The boxer pays the ransom money but the girl is still not released. Her boyfriend decides to get her back his own way, killing her ruthless captor in a fierce duel.

programme.title: Shoot the Living and Pray for the Dead
programme.desc: After Dan Hogan and his gang rob a bank, they hire a mysterious man to guide them across the Mexican border in return for half of the loot.

programme.title: Tequila Joe
programme.desc: A young deputy tries to sober and revitalize a washed up, alcoholic sheriff to take down a pair of warring gangs of criminals in the Old West.

programme.title: War of the Wildcats
programme.desc: In 1906, on Oklahoma's Indian lands, a cowboy fights for oil lease rights against a greedy oilman while a pretty schoolteacher steals both men's hearts.

programme.title: Duel in the Sun
programme.desc: After her father is executed, Pearl Chavez moves in with distant relatives in Texas. While Laura Belle and Jesse welcome her, the ranch’s patriarch despises her, and rebellious son Lewt becomes dangerously obsessed. As Pearl is torn between desire and danger, family tensions explode around her.

programme.title: New Frontier (1939)
programme.desc: The state government plans to build a flood-control dam and condemns the property of the local farmers and ranchers, including The Three Mesquiteers. The state intends to compensate the land-owners fairly, but a crooked real-estate promoter complicates things. The ranchers, led by Stony Brooke ('John Wayne' (q)), Tucson Smith ('Ray Corrigan') and Rusty Joslin (Raymond Hatton) fight back against both the law and the crooks.

programme.title: I'll Die for Vengeance
programme.desc: A Mexican gang headed by vicious Pedro terrorizes the land between New Mexico and Arizona.

programme.title: Western Kid
programme.desc: Andrea Balestri has dubbed himself Kid Terror O’Hara, leader of a group of children who head to the ghost town of Torque to play cowboy games.

programme.title: The Shooting
programme.desc: A mysterious woman persuades two cowboys to help her in a revenge scheme.

programme.title: The Deadly Companions
programme.desc: An ex-army officer accidentally kills a woman's son and tries to make up for it by escorting the funeral procession through dangerous Indian territory.

programme.title: Wyatt Earp S01E17-20
programme.desc: In one of television's first adult Westerns, the famous marshal puts his life on the line to maintain order, first in Dodge City, Kan., then in Tombstone, Ariz.

programme.title: Bad Man's River
programme.desc: Robber Roy King loses his wife, Alicia, to revolutionary Montero. Despite their rivalry they collaborate in an attempt to rob the Mexican government of one million dollars.

programme.title: Pancho Villa
programme.desc: A double-cross in an arms deal prompts Mexican revolutionary Pancho Villa to raid a US Army weapons depot in Columbus, New Mexico.

programme.title: Man, Pride And Vengeance
programme.desc: A stalwart Spanish soldier turns to a life of crime to prove his love for a mysterious and promiscuous gypsy woman.

programme.title: No Killing Without Dollars
programme.desc: Lawrence White returns to Owell Rock seeking revenge for his father’s murder. To protect his identity and strategy, he adopts a new name and hires another man to impersonate Lawrence White, setting a dangerous game of deception and vengeance in motion.

programme.title: The Man from Utah
programme.desc: In a horse-riding rodeo contest bad guys want John Weston to lose. When he doesn't go along they add some insurance: a poisoned needle just under his saddle.

programme.title: Apache Rifles
programme.desc: In 1879 Arizona, Captain Jeff Stanton leads a cavalry unit to return the Mescalero Apaches to their reservation after attacks on settlers. Capturing the chief's son, Stanton negotiates a fragile truce, but greedy townsfolk plot to break it. As Stanton is replaced by a harsher commander, tensions rise, leading to disastrous consequences for both sides.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Simplicity is key with Sicilian cuisine and Chef Michael Bonacini explores just how the region balances simplicity with intensity through four flavourful dishes. Starting with an antipasto of Folded Flatbread with Ricotta and Fennel Seeds, Michael inspires with its intricate beauty with a simple recipe. Keeping to the theme of simplicity, Michael shows that plenty of flavour can come from little ingredients in his primo of Broccoli and Sausage Rigatoni. The spicy sausage and chili is countered by a creamy broccoli pesto for a dish that highlights Sicilian cuisine. Michael turns to the Italian queen of crops for his secondo: Eggplant Parmesan Roll-Ups. With thin slices of eggplant rolled up to contain a mouth-watering mixture of mozzarella, provolone, and pecorino romano, this dish gets an extra kick of flavour from a coating of breadcrumbs and tomato sauce. To bring it all together, Michael combines spicy with sweet through his tender Spiced Chocolate Cookies.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Filled with ruins in its bustling streets, the region of Lazio sticks with grandeur in all it does, including food! To introduce us to Lazio, Host Michael Bonacini highlights its Jewish influence with a crispy Roman Jewish-style Artichokes. As crunchy as a potato chip, Michael's artichokes are a delicious fried treat that are a perfect way to kick off a delicious meal. For his primo Michael brings together simple ingredients to create a rich Bucatini with Amatriciana Sauce. Michael's secondo turns what was once peasant food into a delectable and tender dish. Cooked with a blend of vegetables and sauce, Michael's Braised Oxtail brings forth the history of cuisine. Returning to Rome for his final dish, Michael cooks up the popular Sour Cherry and Ricotta Tart. With the tart cherries countered by the creamy ricotta, every decadent bite offers a world of taste.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Campania's beautiful coastline is filled with two things: tourists and seafood. Diving into the culture of the region, Celebrity Chef Michael Bonacini begins his meal with a salad from the Island of Capri. Putting a twist on the classic dish, Michael's Grilled Caprese Salad combines fresh tomatoes, tangy balsamic, and a hint of sweetness from basil. For his primo, Michael serves up bold flavours with his Spaghetti Puttanesca. Mixing salty and sweet, this sauce offers a delicious take on the typical plate of spaghetti. Looking to the coast for his secondo, Michael quickly cooks up aromatic and spicy Herb-stuffed Scallops and Grilled Broccoli Rabe. For his dolce Michael whips up a dessert made for a celebration: Rum Babas. Typically for special occasions, each bite of Rum Babas offers pure sweetness with a fresh citrus zest.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Chef Michael Bonacini delves into the Italian region of Emilia- Romagna to discover its iconic cuisine. To start, Michael stays light with an airy Mortadella Mousse spread on fluffy Modena Mini Flatbreads. Next, Michael cooks up Tortellini in Broth, a dish originally from Bologna that can be easily altered to personal taste. Michael chooses to fill his tortellini with a rich and savoury mixture of prosciutto, mortadella, and ground pork. For his secondo, Michael uses traditional ingredients and pairs them in a tart, luxurious dish of Duck Breast with Balsamic Cherry Sauce. To wind down his meal, Michael whips up a creamy classic, Rice Custard Cake topped with a Cherry Glaze.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Chef Michael Bonacini explores sweet and spicy dishes hailing from the coastal region of Calabria. For his antipasto, Michael cooks up a light and refreshing Brioche with Gelato. Fluffy brioche buns surround the sweet flavours of gelato for a delicious start to your meal. Switching to spice for the primo, Michael introduces a Spicy Sausage and Ricotta Pasta. Full of sweet, savoury, and spicy flavours, this dish provides a strong, flavourful meal sure to please any crowd. For his secondo, Michael goes for a hearty Lamb au Gratin with Peas and Asparagus; a classic holiday dish that will warm any room. For his finale, Michael whips up a simple, yet impressive, Chocolate-covered Figs.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Full of luxurious treats, the northern Italian region of Lombardy offers rich and delicious cuisine. For his antipasto, celebrity chef Michael Bonacini prepares a delicate dish of Stuffed Squash Blossoms. Soft and light, these blossoms are enhanced with a creamy filling of parmesan, anchovies, and nutmeg. Following the fresh taste of flowers, Michael cooks up an impressive and rich Risotto Milanese. A feast for your eyes and taste buds, this risotto is coloured by saffron and its floral strands release flavour and colour as it's cooked. For his secondo Michael pairs a succulent Veal Roast with the sweet and sour Mustard Fruit to bring out a tangy delight. Michael's dolce looks solely at chocolate, creating a creamy and crunchy Chocolate Salami. Full of nuts, cookies, and creamy chocolate, this rich dessert is a wonderful way to finish off any meal.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Known for its lush landscape, Umbria is a region of that offers fresh, seasonal ingredients perfect for simple yet boldly flavoured cuisine. To begin his Umbrian feast, Chef Michael Bonacini serves up a sweet and spicy antipasto of Fried Spicy Tomato Flatbread. Seasoned with chili peppers for that bit of heat, Michael's antipasto is a humble yet satisfying snack. For his primo, Michael brings our attention to an Umbrian specialty: truffles! Prepared with light and fluffy pasta, Michael's Gnocchi with Black Truffle concentrates the decadent flavour of the truffle in the pillowy pasta to create a rich and delectable dish. Paying homage to the plights of farmers and fisherman, Michael's secondo combines the delicious flavours of land and sea. Michael's seasoned Seared Fish is paired with sweet and savoury lentils for a warm and homey dish. Finally, for Michael's dolce he bakes a warm and wintery Umbrian classic: Umbrian strudel.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Appreciating island culture, host Michael Bonacini explores the enchanting region of Sardegna and its exceptional cuisine. Michael begins his island feast with a taste of the sea through his seasoned antipasto of Stuffed Snails. Next, Michael prepares a luxurious and delicate Lobster Spaghetti, highlighting the fresh seafood of the region. Moving inland for his secondo, Michael cooks up a traditional dish of Lamb with Artichokes and Saffron, a meal that combines three of Sardegna's most famous ingredients. To end his meal, Michael combines salty and sweet with a dolce of Honey and Cheese Fritters.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: One of Italy's quieter regions, Friuli Venezia Guilia offers iconic decadent dishes, waiting to be discovered. Renowned chef Michael Bonacini begins his exploration of the region with his take on a traditional meal: Cheese Crisp Baskets with Polenta and Mushrooms. This savoury antipasto is an elegant looking dish with humble flavours. For his primo, Michael prepares a unique Poppy Seed, Sage, and Prosciutto Pasta, a dish that is a twist on traditional pasta. Looking for a little heat in his secondo, Michael cooks up a meal of Spicy Tomato Scampi. The sweet meat of the scampi counters the heat of the sauce, creating a delicious flavour combination. To end his meal, Michael looks to the region's Austrian influence by preparing his dolce of Apricot Sweet Buns. Soft, sweet, and light these buns are the perfect way to wrap up a Friuli Venezia Guilia meal.

programme.title: Up the Dish
programme.desc: Host Poppy Sandler kicks off Up the Dish with her version of mom's spaghetti - a scrumptious Spaghetti Pomodoro that takes it to the top! Next up to the plate is Missy Hui, who hits it out of the park with her heavenly Bun Viet, a sweet and sour vermicelli noodle bowl and citrusy lemongrass grilled pork combo. Then, Tiera Singh takes up the challenge with her vegetarian Miso Ramen - an umami flavour bomb of miso, mirin, and even more noodle goodness. But there's nowhere to go but up with Micah's Lobster Cantonese Chow Mein, an elegantly upscaled rendition of Chinese noodles with bright ginger, tender gai lan, and crisp chow mein, all coated in an exquisite black bean sauce.

programme.title: Up the Dish
programme.desc: Crack open a mussel or two, this episode of Up the Dish begins in Belgium, but please, no waffles! Host Micah Trainor makes Moules- Frites, mussels steamed in white wine and shows her trick for bistro- style French fries. Next, Tiera Singh steals the show with her Mussel Broth Vichyssoise and Smoked Mussels, an ultra-creamy cold soup that's paired with smoky shellfish for fantastic flavour. Vegetarian mussels? Missy Hui says no worries! and makes Saffron Artichokes with zesty Lemon Chili Oil - there's a little bit of everything in each delectable bite! How does Poppy Sandler send the episode off? By turning it on its head! Fried mussels with Celeriac Remoulade salad makes for a satisfying ending to Up the Dish.

programme.title: Up the Dish
programme.desc: In this episode of Up the Dish, host Missy Hui goes back to her childhood with Chicken and Dumplings - comfort food for every age! The chicken-dumpling journey doesn't end there; Micah Trainor turns the dish upside down and inside out with her Chinese-inspired Chicken-Chive Gyoza, a crunchy-crispy dim sum delight, with an ovERS-the-top chili sauce! How does Poppy Sandler spice things up? Herb Gnudi with Red Pepper Sauce, a spicy-savoury dumpling that's coated in nutty brown butter and creamy ricotta cheese for extra oomph. Tiera Singh finishes with another European dish - Spinach Spaetzle and Crispy Prosciutto, straight from Germany! Chewy spaetzle, fresh spinach, crispy ham - this textural treat doesn't let up!

programme.title: Up the Dish
programme.desc: How do you make any lasagna recipe better? Ask Tiera Singh to take it up, of course! Her 'Nonna-style' bechamel and Bolognese-based Lasagna is topped with melty mozzarella for a luscious and luxuriant dish. Tiera tosses it over to Poppy Sandler, whose sideways Seafood Lasagna mixes up mussels, shrimp, and a briny bechamel sauce - yum! Next, Micah Trainor makes a dressed-up vegetarian version of the classic - her Zucchini-Mushroom Lasagna Rolls with tangy sundried tomatoes, savoury ricotta cheese, and earthy mushroom duxelles is simply superlative. Missy Hui hits the sweet spot with her Chocolate Raspberry Dessert Lasagna; layers of rich white chocolate, thick raspberry coulis, and velvety mascarpone cheese come together for a dessert that's in the stratosphere!

programme.title: Up the Dish
programme.desc: In this episode of Up the Dish, host Micah Trainor takes a stab at Cassoulet with buttery white beans, duck leg confit, and flavourful French sausage - and the result is mouth-wateringly good! The pressure's on, but Tiera Singh doesn't let up with her Chinese Long Bean Stir Fry. Succulent sausage, delicious duck breast, and flavorful vegetables come together for a truly sumptuous dish! For her vegetarian variant, Missy Hui must move things up a notch, but how? Agedashi Tofu! Breaded crispy semi-firm tofu is doused in a dashi, gochujang, and mirin mixture for the ultimate umami mouthful. Poppy Sandler goes above and beyond with her Chocolate-crusted Elk Loin, seared and drizzled with a decadent Coffee- Blueberry Demi-Glace - sound strange? Tastes terrific!

programme.title: Up the Dish
programme.desc: Who said dessert couldn't come before dinner? In this episode of Up the Dish, host Missy Hui serves up a hedonistically hard-to-beat Carrot Cake, made extra-moist with applesauce and tons of cream cheese icing. Micah Trainor ditches dessert and heads for the healthy option - a Cider Poached Chicken Waldorf Salad full of pecans and cinnamon for that classic cake flavour. Poppy Sandler innovates with Indian inspiration - carrot cake becomes Carrot Rostis, thin pancakes dished out with perfectly poached eggs and a homemade savoury raisin jam. Tiera Singh returns to the Rock and makes Jerk Crab Salad Mango Rolls. Jazzing up the crab meat with a blend of Jamaican jerk and autumn spices, she finishes the dish by wrapping the mixture in layers of smooth avocado slices and juicy mango.

programme.title: Up the Dish
programme.desc: First up on this episode of Up the Dish is Poppy Sandler's Borscht straight from the Eastern Bloc! A mix of roasted and simmered beets adds complexity to the creamy soup - and don't forget that vivid burgundy hue. Tiera Singh swaps soup for a sandwich with her Beet-Stained Trout Gravlax, pairing the eye-catching seafood with zesty lemon-dill cream cheese and rye pumpernickel bread. Next, Micah Trainor mixes up a vegetarian Roasted Beet Salad paired with crackly Seed Brittle and a simple sweet dressing; it's a crunchy, earthy delight! Missy Hui's three-layer Red Beet Velvet Cake is a true triple threat. Red beet puree gives this cake its vermillion colour - and pairing it with tangy goat cheese icing... well, it just makes sense!

programme.title: Up the Dish
programme.desc: Micah Trainor boils it down for this episode of Up the Dish! Her Cajun Seafood Boil simmers with luscious lobster, smoky andouille, and supERS-sized crab; a perfect blend of zesty, spicy, and succulent. It's a hard act to follow, but Missy Hui is up for it. Her Corned Beef Boiled Dinner is a call back to the Emerald Isle - home-cured pickled beef bubbles away with veggies in a beefy broth. Poppy Sandler's vegetarian addition? Moroccan Vegetable Stew! A North African-style spice blend heats this dish up, while chickpeas and other veggies soak up the flavour. Tiera Singh takes a spicy approach with her one-pot delight - Guyanese Pepperpot. Loaded with scotch-bonnet peppers, osso bucco, and demi-glace, this dish delivers a rich and impressive punch to the tastebuds.

programme.title: Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: Chef Spencer starts this spicy barbeque episode with flavours from Thailand with a Bok Choy with a Ginger Chili Sauce. Powerful bird's eye chilies are packed into a sweet and spicy sauce and served over tasty grilled bok choy. Spencer then introduces us to Calabrian chilies, mashed into a spice paste and rubbed on butterflied chicken that then gets grilled to flame-kissed perfection. Next, Spencer gives fresh calamari some heat with Korean chilies that add their distinctive heat and flavour before grilling this scrumptious recipe and serving it over a comforting bed of rice and peas. Finally, Spencer prepares Seekh Kabobs, made with ground lamb spiked with punchy dried Kashmiri chilies and a blend of fresh hot peppers.

programme.title: Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: First stop on Chef Spencer's Spanish flavour tour? Habanero Char-Grilled Octopus - warmed up with punchy chilies and balanced with a sweet and tangy sherry vinaigrette. Next, Spencer stuffs whole sea bass with citrus and herbs, gives it the grill treatment and then tops it with olive oil blistered cherry tomatoes. The rotisserie does the heavy lifting for Mr. Watts' whole roast chicken - spiked with bright Spanish flavours like Spanish chilies and smoked paprika, slow cooked and served extra juicy. Finally, Spencer prepares a classic Spanish recipe: Paella. Loaded saffron rice, piled high with chorizo, veggies, and shellfish. Of course, Spencer's Paella is made in the Spanish tradition; outside, over the fire, on a beautiful sunny day!

programme.title: Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: It's all about beautiful butter in this episode of Watts on the Grill! First up, entertaining host Spencer fires tosses clams in velvety butter, zesty garlic and earthy spices to make his Clams with Garlic Paprika Butter. Next up is a traditional Indian recipe, but done on the grill - Butter Chicken! All the butter chicken flavours we love are infused in the marinade, before getting crisped up on the fiery grill - the result is both classic and completely new! Scallops are next, grilled and served with a mouth-watering caper-raisin butter. For his final recipe; Chef Watts prepares a rich and juicy grilled Rib Steak topped with a decadent port wine compound butter. Oh, what a butter-loving day!

programme.desc: A former bothy in Fife, an end terrace in Nottinghamshire and a semi in Feltham near Heathrow airport are sold under the hammer. Martin, Lucy and Dion meet the new owners.

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: A flat with a sea view in Helensburgh in Scotland, a lodge house in West Bridgford in Nottinghamshire and a chalet bungalow in Callington in Cornwall are all sold under the hammer.

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: A former pub in Folkestone, a semi in Sutton Coldfield and a terrace in Telford are sold under the hammer. Martin, Lucy and Dion travel to Kent, Birmingham and Shropshire to meet the new owners and hear their plans.

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: A house ripe for extending in New Haw in Surrey, a three bed semi calling out for a fourth bedroom in Langwith on the Nottinghamshire Derbyshire boarder and a former school site in Wales are all sold under the hammer.

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: A two bedroom flat in a period house in Walthamstow in London, a former health centre in Mansfield in Nottinghamshire and a terraced house in Heanor in Derbyshire are all sold under the hammer.

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: A chalet bungalow on the Notts Derbyshire boarder, a terraced house in Reigate in Surrey and a bungalow with a view in Braystones in Cumbria are all sold under the hammer. Martin, Lucy and Dion meet the new owners.

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: Its a family affair with a trio of father and son developers, bidding on auction buys in Dover, Wolverhampton and Londons Wandsworth. Martin, Lucy and Dion talk to the dads and their sons to hear what their plans are to make money.

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: A semi in St Austell in Cornwall, a mid-terrace in Croydon and a former hotel in Southampton are sold under the hammer. Martin, Lucy and Dion meet the new owners to hear their ambitious plans to make money from their investments.

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: An end terrace in Walsall in the West Midlands, a basement flat in Tunbridge Wells and a bungalow in Hinkley in Leicestershire are bought under the hammer by developers hoping to make some money.

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: Martin meets a young family with a toddler and a newborn who buy a house near Stoke on Trent to live in. Dion and Lucy talk to developers who have bought a terraced house in Darwen in Lancashire and a maisonette in Londons Plumstead.

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: Martin, Lucy and Dion meet the new owners of a quaint terraced cottage in Clent in Worcestershire, a terraced house in South Croydon, and a big house in Edgbaston and follow the progress of the investors hoping to make money from their auction buys.

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: A grand Edwardian home in Eltham in London, a piece of land near Birmingham and a property in Newcastle-under-Lyme all go under the hammer. Martin, Lucy and Dion meet the new owners and hear their plans.

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: Martin meets a couple wanting to transform a rundown house into a forever home, Dion talks to two friends embarking on their first property adventure while Lucy meets a seasoned property developer and his son who have a three phase plan.

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: A former bank in Crewe is sold at auction, but will it prove a nice little earner for its new owner? In Cumbria a flood damaged home is bought to benefit the community, and in London a developer has grand plans for a two bedroom flat in Tooting.

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: Martin is on the North Wales coast, Dion is in Derby and Lucys in Maidstone, Kent. The developers are considering adding bedrooms and putting in new bathrooms and kitchens, but will splashing the cash net them more money?

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: A super dad helps his daughter out buying and transforming a maisonette for her to live in, and in Derby two friends hope to create smart accommodation for seven students. In Rainham in Kent a developer has ambitious plans to smarten up a shop.

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: A film extra buys a flat to refurbish in Folkestone in Kent, while another developer has ambitious plans for a former council depot in Milton in Stoke on Trent and two footballing friends take on a detached 1930s house in Norbury in London.

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: Two brothers buy a bungalow for their mother in Staffordshire and elsewhere property developers buy a huge barn in Upwell in Norfolk and a large three bedroom flat in Londons Tooting.

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: There's a plan to transform a Victorian terrace in York into a home, while developers in Rainham, Kent, want to build flats on land sandwiched between two busy roads and investors hope to restore a flood damaged Cumbrian property.

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: A damp and dingy basement flat in Kilburn with space for an extension, a former post office in Gedney Dyke in Lincolnshire and a bungalow in Cornwalls Liskeard are sold under the hammer.

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: A large listed Georgian house in Faversham is given the wow factor and developers in Witham St Annes in Lancashire and New Southgate in London also deliver top notch finishes on their very different flats. Martin, Lucy and Dion follow their progress.

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: Lucy is in Catford to follow progress on a one bedroom flat its new owners hope to turn into a two bed. Dion is in Wigton looking at a house with a flying freehold and Martin is in a large end of terraced house in Blackpool.

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: Lucy talks to a developer with ambitious plans for a three bed semi in Croydon, Martin looks round another semi in Derbys Alvaston and Dion follows progress of a house damaged by the 2015 Cumbrian floods as it's restored to its former glory.

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: A trio of three bedroom properties make for two forever homes and an investment flat in todays show. Dion follows progress on a mum of twos dreams of transforming a Victorian house in Newcastle under Lyme into a wonderful family home.

programme.title: Homes Under The Hammer
programme.desc: Two cottages and a terraced house sold under the hammer are renovated by investors wanting to create homes and make some money. Lucy looks round a cottage in Upstreet near Canterbury while Dion checks out a terrace near Birmingham.

programme.title: Kidnapping Mr. Heineken
programme.desc: Sisäpiirin tarina olutmoguli Alfred Freddy Heinekenin sieppaajien suunnittelusta, toteutuksesta, rajuista jälkimainingeista ja lopullisesta tuhosta vuonna 1983, mikä johti suurimpiin koskaan maksettuihin lunnaisiin yksilöstä.

programme.title: Manhattan
programme.desc: Tässä modernissa klassikossa Isaacilla (Woody Allen) on liian nuori tyttöystävä ja ex-vaimo, joka on laatimassa paljastustarinaa heidän elämästään. Mutta tavatessaan Maryn (Diane Keaton) alkaa hänen täyttymyksen etsintänsä rakkaalla Manhattanillaan.

programme.title: Toivon tuolla puolen
programme.desc: TOIVON TUOLLA PUOLEN kertoo hiililaivalla Helsinkiin rantautuvasta Khaledista (Sherwan Haji), Syyrian sodan pakolaisesta, joka etsii matkalla kadonnutta sisartaan.

programme.title: Ariel
programme.desc: Ariel kertoo Taistosta (Turo Pajala, Hamlet liikemaailmassa), pohjoissuomalaisesta kaivosmiehestä. Kun kaivos suljetaan, Taisto kääntää Cadillacin keulan kohti etelää. Helsingissä Taisto asuu Pelastusarmeijan yömajassa, etsii työtä ja rakastuu uutteraan yksinhuoltajaäitiin.

programme.title: Arvottomat
programme.desc: Arvottomat on ajaton kuvaus siitä kuinka Pikkurikollinen Manne, maalaispoika Harri ja kaunis Veera ajavat Volgalla läpi suomalaismaisemien, poliisien ja gangsterien roikkuessa herkeämättä kintereillä.

programme.title: Vieraampi kuin fiktio
programme.desc: Verohallinnon tarkastaja huomaa yhtäkkiä olevansa vain hänen kuulemansa kerronnan kohteena: kertomus, joka alkaa vaikuttaa hänen koko elämäänsä; hänen työstään; hänen rakkautensa; hänen kuolemaansa.

programme.title: Carol
programme.desc: Nuori Therese Belivet (Rooney Mara) työskentelee tavaratalossa 1950-luvun alun Manhattanilla ja unelmoi täydemmästä elämästä. Hän tapaa Carol Airdin (Cate Blanchett), viehättävän kypsän naisen, joka on loukussa murenevassa kulissiavioliitossa.
Nuoren kirjailijan on hyväksyttävä kuolevaisuutensa kun hänellä todetaan harvinainen syöpä.Parhaan ystävänsä ja empaattisen nuoren terapeutin avulla hän löytää rohkeuden taistella sairautta vastaan.

programme.title: Toivon lähteet
programme.desc: Oltuaan 30 vuotta naimisissa keski-ikäinen pariskunta ryhtyy intensiiviseen viikon kestävään pariterapiaan työstääkseen parisuhdettaan.

programme.title: The Mothman Prophecies
programme.desc: Journalisti John Klein ja hänen vaimonsa Mary joutuvat kohtalokkaaseen onnettomuuteen. Vaimon kuoleman jälkeen Johnin pakkomielteeksi muodostuvat Maryn sairaalassa tekemät luonnokset, jotka kuvaavat tummaa, siivekästä hahmoa.

programme.title: Chariot
programme.desc: Seitsemän toisilleen tuntematonta ihmistä herää matkustajalentokoneessa tietämättä lainkaan, miksi he ovat siellä - tai minne kone on menossa.

programme.title: The Contract
programme.desc: Ray Keene (John Cusack), isä, joka haluaa lunastaa paikkansa poikansa (Jamie Anderson) silmissä, yrittää saada maailmanluokan salamurhaajan Cardenin (Morgan Freeman) oikeuden eteen.

programme.title: The Dreamers
programme.desc: Kolme elokuvantuntijaa, amerikkalainen vaihto-opiskelija Matthew sekä kaksoset Théo ja Isabelle ovat tulleet läheisiksi yhteisen kiinnostuksen kohteensa vuoksi. Théon ja Isabellen epätavallinen intiimi yhteys kiehtoo Matthew’ta.

programme.title: In the Name of God
programme.desc: Elokuva Jumalanpalvelus kertoo Theodorista, joka on pappi pienessä kylässä, josta tulee puheenaihe siitä syystä, että hänen vaimonsa parani kuin ihmeen kautta tappavasta taudista Theodorin rukousten ansiosta.

programme.title: You're Not You
programme.desc: Kaksinkertainen Oscar-voittaja Hillary Swank on menestynyt konserttipianisti Kate, jossa todetaan parantumaton sairaus ALS. Hänen perheensä järjestää hänelle parasta mahdollista hoitoa, mutta Kate itse antautuu täysin epäpätevän Becin hoiviin.

programme.title: The Shamrock Spitfire
programme.desc: Tositarina irlantilaisesta hävittäjälentäjä Brendan ”Paddy” Finucanesta, josta vain 21-vuotiaana tuli Royal Air Forcen nuorin laivueenkomentaja ja yksi toisen maailmansodan suurimmista ja palkituimmista hävittäjä-ässistä.

programme.title: I, Daniel Blake
programme.desc: 59-vuotias Daniel Blake (Dave Johns) on työskennellyt suurimman osan elämästään puuseppänä Newcastlessa. Sydänkohtauksen ja työtapaturman suistettua hänen elämänsä raiteiltaan hän saa huomata, ettei yhteiskunnan turvaverkko kannattelekaan kaikkia.

programme.title: Toivon tuolla puolen
programme.desc: TOIVON TUOLLA PUOLEN kertoo hiililaivalla Helsinkiin rantautuvasta Khaledista (Sherwan Haji), Syyrian sodan pakolaisesta, joka etsii matkalla kadonnutta sisartaan.

programme.title: Teen Spirit
programme.desc: Rikkinäisessä perheessä kasvanut 17-vuotias Violet (Fanning) unelmoi pop-tähteydestä ja paosta pienestä englantilaisesta kotikylästään.

programme.title: Ariel
programme.desc: Ariel kertoo Taistosta (Turo Pajala, Hamlet liikemaailmassa), pohjoissuomalaisesta kaivosmiehestä. Kun kaivos suljetaan, Taisto kääntää Cadillacin keulan kohti etelää. Helsingissä Taisto asuu Pelastusarmeijan yömajassa, etsii työtä ja rakastuu uutteraan yksinhuoltajaäitiin.

programme.title: Management
programme.desc: Lasillinen samppanjaa ja taputus pepulle voi viedä pitkälle! Turhautunut uranainen myyntimatkalla ja sekopäinen motellinjohtaja, joka pitää halvasta samppanjasta ja pyöreästä takapuolesta? Ei kuulosta hyvältä yhdistelmältä, mutta mitä vaan voi tapahtua autiossa tienvarsihotellissa...

programme.title: Vieraampi kuin fiktio
programme.desc: Verohallinnon tarkastaja huomaa yhtäkkiä olevansa vain hänen kuulemansa kerronnan kohteena: kertomus, joka alkaa vaikuttaa hänen koko elämäänsä; hänen työstään; hänen rakkautensa; hänen kuolemaansa.

programme.title: Ride
programme.desc: Newyorkilainen työhullu kustannustoimittaja Jackie seuraa poikaansa Los Angelesiin. Poika haluaa jättää opiskelut sikseen ja elää unelmaansa Kaliforniassa, missä myös äidillä on pian edessään tyrskyjä ja kuohuja.

programme.title: Black Butterfly
programme.desc: Vuoristokaupungin ulkopuolella, jota kamppailee sarjan sieppauksia ja murhia, erakkomainen kirjailija Paul (Antonio Banderas) kamppailee aloittaakseen käsikirjoituksen, jonka hän toivoo pelastavan uransa.

programme.title: The Cabin
programme.desc: Nuoripari matkustaa syrjäiselle mökille selvittelemään suhdettaan. Sitten mökille ilmestyy yllätysvieras; tuntematon mies pahat mielessä. Matkasta tulee oikea painajainen, ja nuoret joutuvat kamppailemaan hengestään.

programme.title: The Contract
programme.desc: Ray Keene (John Cusack), isä, joka haluaa lunastaa paikkansa poikansa (Jamie Anderson) silmissä, yrittää saada maailmanluokan salamurhaajan Cardenin (Morgan Freeman) oikeuden eteen.

programme.title: Kidnapping Mr. Heineken
programme.desc: Sisäpiirin tarina olutmoguli Alfred Freddy Heinekenin sieppaajien suunnittelusta, toteutuksesta, rajuista jälkimainingeista ja lopullisesta tuhosta vuonna 1983, mikä johti suurimpiin koskaan maksettuihin lunnaisiin yksilöstä.

programme.title: Cha Cha Cha
programme.desc: Siltojen alla asusteleva alkoholisti Matti (Matti Pellonpää) on saamassa Amerikan tädiltään huomattavan perinnön, mutta miehen tulisi olla edustuskelpoinen tädin vierailun ajan. Matti kertoo tilanteesta autokauppiaana työskentelevälle ystävälleen, joka ehdottaa korvausta vastaan roolien vaihtoa.

programme.title: Where Echoes End
programme.desc: Hunter attempts to clear the name of a fellow detective accused of a lucrative scheme.

programme.title: Fatal Obsession, Part 2

programme.title: The Garbage Man
programme.desc: Hunter and McCall must track down a killer who has been shooting parolees.

programme.title: The Avenging Angel

programme.desc: A cocaine dealer being escorted by an obnoxious detective escapes. Hunter and the detective pursue her.

programme.title: Fire Man

programme.desc: Hunter and McCall investigate a Chinese gang leader being pursued by a police officer with a personal interest

programme.title: Million Dollar Misunderstanding
programme.desc: Hunter and McCall pursue a security guard turned thief as he searches for the money he stole and lost.

Sashi rolls into town with no knowledge of Vietnamese cuisine, and he gets an indepth street food 101 tour of the city. From learning about haute Franco-Vietnamese cuisine with the city’s best French chefs, to a simple and honest bowl of pho. In this episode, Sashi uncovers the bustling city of Hanoi and all its trappings. Secret alleyways leading to decades old cafes offering famous brews like egg coffee; to iconic places that serve French style baguettes and everything in between!

Over the next 2 episodes, Sashi will explore the country from coast to coast, to understand how the cuisine changes as the kilometers rack up; This episode starts off with a rendezvous with Mumbai’s hottest chef, Prateek Sadhu. Sashi takes an inside look into how the city’s most popular restaurant, Masque does their signature 8 hands collaborative event. With Prateek and his star studded guest chefs, Matt Orlando from Copenhagen and Ivan Brehm from Nouri in Singapore; the trio head to Delhi for an ingredients scoring mission. From biodynamic farms in the outskirts to the old Delhi...

programme.desc: Two sisters go on a mini-crime spree, get caught and find no one will bail them out. A domestic argument about night fishing lands a husband in jail for breaking into his own car. An irate inmate blows off steam by doing laps in her jail cell. A woman finds out it’s hard to stop selling drugs when the neighborhood knows her business.

programme.title: Jail
programme.desc: After totaling his Corvette, a man is arrested for drunk driving. Complex personality issues are unveiled while an inmate is interrogated. A man is placed in a mask after spraying saliva far and wide.

programme.title: Jail
programme.desc: A woman is charged with possession of a controlled substance. A woman denies assaulting her husband, and two aggressive cousins threaten police and end up in isolation.

programme.title: Jail
programme.desc: A woman stalking David Copperfield is arrested. An inebriated inmate voices her displeasure with the guards, and a man nabbed for driving under the influence of prescription drugs howls for his dog.

programme.title: Jail
programme.desc: In Las Vegas, NV an honest offender turns himself in. Officers arrest an underage woman who admits to driving under the influence. A woman is taken into custody after harming herself with a pair of scissors

programme.title: Jail
programme.desc: A man admits to urinating in public. A couple spends their date night in jail after being over served, and a DUI suspect passes out during booking.

programme.title: Jail
programme.desc: Deputies deal with chaos after volatile inmates begin fighting. Accusations of deceit plague a booking as a woman is arrested for drunk driving. Prisoners are restrained after causing a commotion.

programme.title: Jail
programme.desc: An intoxicated man claims to be connected to the occupy Wall Street movement. Officers struggle with a combative man, and a tearful candy thief is taken into custody.

programme.title: Jail
programme.desc: An inmate swallows a stash of drugs and then comes down with a case of the munchies. A 72-year-old offers an unusual excuse for dealing drugs to teens at a mall, and a woman charged with assaulting a landlord fakes being sick to get out of jail.

programme.title: Jail
programme.desc: Two men are found fighting on security cameras. Meanwhile, an impromptu tattoo jail parlor is discovered and shut down. Later, a Russian man and his mysterious friend are excited to be in a U.S. jail.

programme.title: Jail
programme.desc: A passenger allegedly attacked a cabdriver. A woman describes assaulting her boyfriend with hot food, and a mother is arrested for leaving her kids in a car while gambling.

programme.title: Jail
programme.desc: A violent ruckus ensues after a man is placed in jail. Secret prison communication methods are explored and examined. Later, deputies cautiously extract a disruptive man while his wife is held nearby.

programme.title: Jail
programme.desc: Officers fear a man may attempt to hang himself and decide to intervene. A heavily injured man ends up in jail after taking cocaine and acid. Irascibility shadows a man with low blood sugar.

programme.title: Jail
programme.desc: In Portland, OR a man in custody accuses officers of being involved in the 1992 event at Ruby Ridge. In Sarasota, FL a drunk man falls off his bike and purports to have been hit by a car. In Las Vegas, LV a daring inmate attempts to make a break for it while the supervising officers attend to a disturbance.

programme.title: Jail
programme.desc: A cell brawl escalates quickly. After being arrested on her wedding night, a woman has deep regrets and serious reflection. Officers free a man from his own noose and place him on a vigilant watch.

programme.title: Jail
programme.desc: A party of three girls are brought in after having been arrested for possession at a nearby music festival. Drugs are found on the person of a music festival attendee during intake. A slightly older party goer is taken into custody for possession.

programme.title: Jail
programme.desc: A man outfitted in just his underwear is taken into custody. A dad gets busted for DUI while on his way to pick up a pizza for his kids. Officers recover drugs from a suspect’s pocket who is puzzled as to how they got there. A woman learns the hard way “what happens in Vegas stays in Vegas”.

programme.title: Jail
programme.desc: An inmate becomes aggressive during a routine pat down. A confused senior citizen thinks the detention center is the site of a poetry slam, and two girlfriends come to blows while gambling.

programme.title: Jail
programme.desc: A code red call blares after a fight occurs in the jail’s dorms. Accused of trespassing, a woman removes her clothes from her holding cell. A man is brought into detox after slamming against a cop car.

programme.title: Jail
programme.desc: A ladies' man smuggles women's underwear into jail. A woman arrested at a traffic accident is incredulous to discover that smoking marijuana while driving is against the law. A young man charged with a DUI tells guards he fears he may become pregnant behind bars.

programme.title: Jail
programme.desc: Officers try to deal with a sloppy and combative drunk. A man gets locked up after he blows all his casino winnings, and a woman gets tricked by her bail bondsman.

programme.title: Jail
programme.desc: A woman comes clean to having drugs hidden where they can’t be seen. An inmate’s exotic makeup is cleverly created with candy and toothpaste. A couple is surprised to find that holding someone against their will is a felony. Doing the right thing turns into an extended stay for a woman with warrants.

programme.title: Jail
programme.desc: An arrested man is caught on camera making a run for freedom. An addict returns to jail and tells officers that meth is controlling his mind. Humility may be the key for one man to quit his life of crime. A shoplifter calls 9-1-1 to help him get out of jail.

programme.title: Jail
programme.desc: A man fresh out of prison tries to prove how tough he is. A drunk woman rages against everyone in her path. A couple’s wedding plans are ruined after officers find their stash of meth, and an arrest leaves an elderly gentleman singing the blues after being processed for a possession charge.

programme.title: Jail
programme.desc: A woman finds herself in jail after telling police she was frightened by a monkey mask. An intoxicate man feels an officer is very special. During a search, an officer finds contraband in a pack of cigarettes that has big consequences to an inmate. A young man says his mom tried to pepper spray him over his brother’s drug use while officers discover the truth to his arrest.

programme.title: Jail
programme.desc: A secret stash is uncovered during a search at a suspect's property. Two rowdy inmates don't quite hit it off when they invade each other's personal space, and a jaywalker experiences problems keeping his pants from falling down.

programme.title: Jail
programme.desc: An inmate interrupts the booking process. A couple is brought in after signs of a domestic dispute but claim they were being intimate, and a jailed woman shares some of her Webcam exploits.

programme.title: Jail
programme.desc: A woman arrested 45 times gives advice to recently released drug users. Two Australian brothers can’t understand why playing a game of “footie” in a hotel hallway would land them in jail. A drunken nightclub security guard wrecks his scooter.

programme.title: Jail
programme.desc: A drug dealer's mean-spirited girlfriend lands herself in isolation. The police deal with an inebriated man accused of throwing rocks, and guards attempt to defuse a situation involving battling cellmates.

programme.title: Jail
programme.desc: An intoxicated woman clashes with officers but later shows that good behavior pays off. An experienced prostitute gives solid advice to a younger woman and begs her to get out of the “game.” An angry woman smashes her cheating boyfriend’s windshield.

programme.title: Jail
programme.desc: A vice unit interrogates several individuals accused of sex crimes. Suicidal threats provoke a high-stakes situation within cell walls. Unable to raise bail, a woman is incarcerated for several days.

programme.title: Jail
programme.desc: In Salt Lake City, UT a combative inmate provokes the use of pepper spray. In Sarasota, FL a drunk woman is uncooperative during processing. In Spokane, WA a man attempts to flip off the camera while taking his mug-shot.

programme.title: Jail
programme.desc: Officers struggle with an angry man after he kicks out a patrol car window. A relationship ends when a woman takes a bite out of her boyfriend. An upset wife stabs her husband and he ends up in handcuffs. A woman is happy to celebrate her birthday by going to jail.

programme.title: Mies vailla menneisyyttä
programme.desc: Mies vailla menneisyyttä kertoo muistinsa menettävästä miehestä, joka aloittaa elämänsä alusta yhteiskunnan köyhimpien keskellä. Mies vailla menneisyyttä sai Cannesin elokuvajuhlien Grand Prix -palkinnon ja Kati Outinen palkittiin roolisuorituksestaan parhaan naisnäyttelijän palkinnolla.

programme.title: Lowlife
programme.desc: Kun helppo elinvarkauskeikka menee pieleen, kohtalon oikku yhdistää kolme yhteiskunnan unohtamaa hylkiötä: Monstruon, meksikolaisen painijan, joka toimii rikospomon turvamiehenä.

programme.title: Ohjelmat jatkuvat pian
programme.desc: Olemme pienillä kauneusunilla! Katso lisää Rakuten TV:n tarjoamaa ilmaisviihdettä.

programme.title: The Wedding Guest
programme.desc: Sarja huvittavia ja onnettomia kohtauksia vain vahvistaa, että hän on rakastuneempi kuin koskaan.

programme.title: Results
programme.desc: PT-valmentajat (Cobie Smulders ja Guy Pearce) saavat tässä fiksussa ja hauskassa rakkautta ja ruumiinkuntoa käsittelevässä komediassa tehtäväkseen saada uusrikas ja hyvin motivoitumaton asiakas (Kevin Corrigan) kuntoon.

programme.title: Ride
programme.desc: Newyorkilainen työhullu kustannustoimittaja Jackie seuraa poikaansa Los Angelesiin. Poika haluaa jättää opiskelut sikseen ja elää unelmaansa Kaliforniassa, missä myös äidillä on pian edessään tyrskyjä ja kuohuja.

programme.title: Bedazzled
programme.desc: Elliot Richards on onneton nuori mies, joka kärsii vastakaiuttomasta rakkaudesta ja haluaa epätoivoisesti muuttaa elämänsä. Hän solmii sopimuksen paholaisen kanssa, ja tämä lupaa toteuttaa hänen toiveensa – mutta sillä on hintansa.

programme.title: Dirty 30
programme.desc: Kate antaa 30-vuotispäivän aattonaan Evielle ja Charlielle luvan järjestää itselleen pirskeet. Juhlista sukeutuu kuitenkin menneisyyttä ja nykyisyyttä sekoitteleva villi peli, ja tilanne riistäytyy kaikkien käsistä.

programme.title: Daniel's Gotta Die
programme.desc: Daniel haluaa lähentyä perheensä kanssa, mutta asiaa mutkistaa se, että kaikki haluavat tappaa hänet perinnön takia.

programme.title: The Right Kind of Wrong
programme.desc: Leo Palamino on epäonnistunut kirjailija, josta tuli tiskaaja. Nyt hänet tunnetaan ex-vaimon pitämästä blogista “Miksi olet paska”, josta on tullut suuri hitti. Sitten Leo tapaa Coletten, unelmiensa naisen… päivänä, jona Colette on menossa naimisiin täydellisen miehen kanssa.

programme.title: Adult Life Skills
programme.desc: Anna on jumissa. Hän on melkein 30, mutta asuu äitinsä puutarhavajassa, ei juttele juuri kenenkään kanssa ja viettää aikansa tekemällä lyhytelokuvia, joissa näyttelevät hänen peukalonsa. Jotakin puuttuu, ja eristyneisyys näyttää olevan Annan tapa käsitellä suurta surua.

programme.title: Superhero Movie
programme.desc: Radioaktiivinen sudenkorento puree orpoa teiniä, joka saa yli-inhimilliset voimat tässä elokuvassa, joka parodioi Hämähäkkimiestä, Ryhmä-X:ää ja Ihmenelosia.

programme.title: Heathers
programme.desc: Tervetuloa Westburgin lukioon jossa halitsee kolme kauneuskuningatarta, Heather C, Heather M ja Heather D. Heillä on valta, ulkonäkö ja rahat tehdäkseen mitä he haluavat.

programme.title: Fat Kid Rules The World
programme.desc: Troy Billings on seitsemäntoista, ylipainoinen ja itsetuhoinen. Juuri kun hän aikoo hypätä bussin eteen, hänet pelastaakin Marcus, lukion kesken jättänyt hurmaava katumuusikko.

programme.title: Growing Up and Other Lies
programme.desc: Vuosia taiteilijana New Yorkissa riutunut Jake aikoo palata kotiin Ohioon. Viimeisenä päivänään kaupungissa hän kutsuu kolme vanhinta ystäväänsä mukaan nostalgiselle kävelyretkelle Manhattanin päästä päähän. Yritys palata huolettomaan nuoruuteen ei suju ihan toiveiden mukaisesti.

programme.title: Next Day Air
programme.desc: Kun lähetti toimittaa vahingossa kätkettyjä kokaiinitiiliä sisältävän paketin väärään osoitteeseen, hän käynnistää tapahtumasarjan...

programme.title: What Just Happened?
programme.desc: Viikko Hollywood-tuottajan Benin elämässä. Ben neuvottelee studiojohtajan kanssa, jotta hänen uusin elokuvansa saisi ensi-iltansa Cannesissa kahden viikon kuluttua. Hän on hermostunut ohjaaja, jonka on tehtävä editointi elokuvaan.

programme.title: Bedazzled
programme.desc: Elliot Richards on onneton nuori mies, joka kärsii vastakaiuttomasta rakkaudesta ja haluaa epätoivoisesti muuttaa elämänsä. Hän solmii sopimuksen paholaisen kanssa, ja tämä lupaa toteuttaa hänen toiveensa – mutta sillä on hintansa.

programme.title: Big Momma's House
programme.desc: Karannutta vankia jahtaava agentti Malcolm Turner (Martin Lawrence) lähtee suorittamaan peitetehtävää ja pukeutuu määräileväksi ja isokokoiseksi mummoksi, joka mottaa yhtä kovaa kuin komentaakin.

programme.title: Peace, Love And Misunderstanding
programme.desc: Komedia menestyksekkäästä newyorkilaisesta asianajajasta (Catherine Keener), joka tuo mukanaan kaksi vilkasta teini-ikäistä lastaan hippiäitinsä (Jane Fonda) luo maalle perhelomalle.

programme.title: Pushing Tin
programme.desc: Nick Falzone on Long Islandin paras lennonjohtaja, kunnes hiljainen muukalainen, Russell Bell, siirretään hänen osastolleen. Näiden New York TRACONin kahden huippulennonjohtajan välinen kilvoittelu eskaloituu mahdollisesti vaaralliselle tasolle.

programme.title: The Way Way Back
programme.desc: Rantakaupunkilomallaan 14-vuotias Duncan vieraantuu äidistään, joka pyrkii päättäväisesti saamaanuuden parisuhteensa toimimaan.

programme.title: Middle School: The Worst Years Of My Life
programme.desc: Rafe Khatchadorianilla on vaikeasti lausuttava sukunimi, valtavan vilkas mielikuvitus... ja ongelmia auktoriteettien kanssa. Rafe ei ole mikään vallankumouksellinen anarkisti, mutta hän on kuitenkin aloittamassa koulunkäyntiä jo järjestyksessä kolmannella yläasteellaan.

programme.title: Yes, God, Yes
programme.desc: Keskilännessä 2000-luvun alussa varttuva 16-vuotias Alice on aina ollut hyvä katolilainen, mutta kun viaton nettikeskustelu muuttuu rohkeaksi, hän löytää masturboinnin ja on syyllisyyden riivaama.

programme.title: Smart People
programme.desc: Tyytymätön vaimonsa kuolemaan, englanninopettaja masentuu ja katkeroituu, mutta löytää silti mahdollisuuden uuteen rakkauteen.

programme.title: Mies vailla menneisyyttä
programme.desc: Mies vailla menneisyyttä kertoo muistinsa menettävästä miehestä, joka aloittaa elämänsä alusta yhteiskunnan köyhimpien keskellä. Mies vailla menneisyyttä sai Cannesin elokuvajuhlien Grand Prix -palkinnon ja Kati Outinen palkittiin roolisuorituksestaan parhaan naisnäyttelijän palkinnolla.

programme.title: Monte Carlo
programme.desc: Grace (Selena Gomez) on tavallinen tyttö, josta tulee vahingossa prinsessa, kun perheen kesämatka Pariisiin muuttuu elämän laajuiseksi fantasiaksi. Grace, joka elää kuin kuninkaallinen kahden parhaan ystävänsä kanssa, huomaa, kuka hän todella on – omaksumalla toisen henkilön identiteetin.

programme.title: The Beach Bum
programme.desc: The Beach Bum seuraa loppuun palaneen Moondogin (Matthew McConaughey) hillittömiä epäonnenkolauksia hänen toimiessaan vain omien pelisääntöjensä mukaan.

programme.title: Nurse Betty
programme.desc: Betty katsoo uskollisesti lempisaippuasarjaansa “Syy rakastaa. Törmättyään kahteen ammattitappajaan katsoessaan yhtä sarjan jaksoa Betty muuttuu “Nurse Bettyksi ja lähtee etsimään sydämensä valittua, tohtori David Ravellia.
